title: lathyrus fulvus
intro: Lathyrus fulvus, commonly known as the golden pea or golden lathyrus, is a species of flowering plant in the genus Lathyrus. It is a perennial legume that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe, and is known for its bright yellow flowers and delicate foliage. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and provide antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus fulvus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
